summary: 019 is mostly coherent and deliberately avoids Registry/Planner/Reference-Architecture/new-candidate complexity. Exact continuity, 207/207 domain tests, 19/19 canonical OpenSpec specs, and Current/Planned/Data-Flow Archify proof reproduce. Without that boundary, accidental source/OpenSpec mutation could occur while derived outputs still validate.
